async function chooseProvider(cfg, argv, ask, interactive) {
  let provider = flag(argv, '--provider');
  let model = flag(argv, '--model');
  if (interactive && !provider) {
    process.stdout.write('\nAI provider for memory extraction:\n');
    config.PROVIDERS.forEach((p, i) => process.stdout.write('  ' + (i + 1) + '. ' + p.padEnd(10) + ' ' + config.PRESETS[p].label + '\n'));
    const answer = await ask('choose 1-' + config.PROVIDERS.length + ' or a name', cfg.provider);
    provider = config.PROVIDERS[Number(answer) - 1] || answer;
  }
  if (provider && !config.PROVIDERS.includes(provider)) throw new Error('unknown provider ' + provider + ' (one of ' + config.PROVIDERS.join(', ') + ')');
  if (provider && provider !== cfg.provider) {
    cfg = config.set('provider', provider).cfg;
    if (!model && cfg.model !== config.PRESETS[provider].model) model = config.PRESETS[provider].model;
  }
  if (interactive && !flag(argv, '--model') && cfg.provider !== 'mock') {
    model = await ask('model id (Enter keeps it)', model || cfg.model);
  }
  if (model && model !== cfg.model) cfg = config.set('model', model).cfg;
  if (cfg.provider === 'openai' && interactive) {
    const url = await ask('OpenAI-compatible base URL (Enter = api.openai.com)', cfg.baseUrl || '');
    if ((url || null) !== cfg.baseUrl) cfg = config.set('baseUrl', url || 'null').cfg;
  }
  say('ok', 'provider ' + cfg.provider + ' · model ' + cfg.model + (cfg.baseUrl ? ' · ' + cfg.baseUrl : ''));
  return cfg;
}

async function setupKey(cfg, argv, ask, interactive) {
  if (cfg.provider === 'mock') {
    say('ok', 'mock provider: no key needed (results are canned fixtures, not real AI output)');
    return true;
  }
  const keyModule = require('./key');
  const stored = secrets.has(cfg.provider) && secrets.read(cfg.provider);
  if (stored) {
    say('ok', 'API key stored for ' + cfg.provider + ' ' + config.maskKey(stored));
    if (!interactive || !yes(await ask('replace it? [y/N]', 'n'))) {
      offerLegacyCleanup(cfg);
      return true;
    }
  } else {
    const file = flag(argv, '--key-file');
    const sources = file ? [{ kind: 'file', where: file, key: readKeyFile(file) }] : legacyKeySources(cfg);
    for (const src of sources.filter((s) => s.key)) {
      const label = src.kind === 'file' ? fwd(src.where) + ' (plain text)' : 'environment variable ' + src.where;
      const take = !interactive || yes(await ask('found an API key in ' + label + '. Move it into the encrypted store? [Y/n]', 'y'));
      if (!take) continue;
      keyModule.save(cfg.provider, src.key);
      say('ok', 'key ' + config.maskKey(src.key) + ' moved into the ' + secrets.backend() + ' store');
      const remove = interactive && yes(await ask(src.kind === 'file'
        ? 'delete the plain-text file ' + fwd(src.where) + ' now? [Y/n]'
        : 'remove ' + src.where + ' from your user environment? [Y/n]', 'y'));
      if (remove && src.kind === 'file') { fs.unlinkSync(src.where); say('ok', 'deleted ' + fwd(src.where)); }
      else if (remove) { keyModule.removeUserEnv(src.where); say('ok', 'removed user environment variable ' + src.where); }
      else say('warn', 'the plain copy in ' + label + ' still exists — delete it when you are ready');
      return true;
    }
    if (!interactive) {
      say('warn', 'no API key yet — run `memo key set` (it will be stored encrypted)');
      return false;
    }
  }
  const url = config.PRESETS[cfg.provider].keyUrl;
  if (url) process.stdout.write('\nGet a key at ' + url + '\n');
  ask.close();
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    let key = '';
    try {
      key = await keyModule.promptHidden('Paste your ' + cfg.provider + ' API key (input hidden), then Enter: ');
    } catch (err) {
      say('warn', 'key entry ' + err.message + ' — run `memo key set` later');
      return false;
    }
    if (!key) { say('warn', 'nothing entered — run `memo key set` later'); return false; }
    try {
      keyModule.save(cfg.provider, key);
      say('ok', 'key ' + config.maskKey(secrets.validKey(key)) + ' stored (' +
        (secrets.backend() === 'dpapi' ? 'encrypted for your Windows account' : 'file readable only by you') + ')');
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      say('fail', err.message);
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// Anthropic Messages API over raw fetch (zero dependencies, plan rule §0.3).
//
// Shape used: POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages
//   headers x-api-key, anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, content-type: application/json
//   body    {model, max_tokens, system, messages:[{role:'user', content}]}
//   reply   {id, model, content:[{type:'text',text}], usage:{input_tokens,output_tokens}, stop_reason}
// Source: bundled claude-api reference (Messages API / current model ids + pricing),

// against today's published docs until one real call succeeds.
//
// Structured-output / JSON mode is deliberately NOT used: the plan allows it only if
// P0 verified it in current docs, and docs/PHASE0_FINDINGS.md §7 is still a template.
// Plain text + extract/validate.js instead.
//
// Note: current Haiku/Sonnet/Opus models think by default and return thinking blocks
// with empty text before the answer, so every text block is collected, not content[0].

const { ProviderError, postJson, withRetries, errorFor } = require('./provider');
const { apiKey } = require('../config');

const URL = 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages';
const VERSION = '2023-06-01';

function textOf(body) {
  if (!body || !Array.isArray(body.content)) return '';
  return body.content
    .filter((block) => block && block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string')
    .map((block) => block.text)
    .join('')
    .trim();
}

function errorMessage(status, text) {
  let detail = '';
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
    if (parsed && parsed.error && typeof parsed.error.message === 'string') detail = parsed.error.message;
    else if (parsed && typeof parsed.message === 'string') detail = parsed.message;
  } catch (_) { /* non-JSON error body */ }
  return 'anthropic ' + status + (detail ? ': ' + detail.slice(0, 200) : '');
}

function create(cfg, opts = {}) {
  const key = opts.apiKey !== undefined ? opts.apiKey : apiKey(cfg);
  return {
    name: 'anthropic',
    model: cfg.model,
    async complete({ system, user, maxTokens = 2000, model = cfg.model }) {
      if (!key) throw new ProviderError('no API key for anthropic — run `memo key set`', { kind: 'auth' });
      return withRetries('anthropic', async () => {
        const res = await postJson(URL, {
          headers: { 'x-api-key': key, 'anthropic-version': VERSION },
          body: { model, max_tokens: maxTokens, system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: user }] },
          timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs,
          fetchImpl: opts.fetchImpl
        });
        const requestId = (res.headers && typeof res.headers.get === 'function' && res.headers.get('request-id')) || null;
        if (res.status !== 200) throw errorFor('anthropic', res, errorMessage(res.status, res.text), requestId);
        let body;
        try { body = JSON.parse(res.text); } catch (err) {
          throw new ProviderError('anthropic returned invalid JSON envelope', { kind: 'retryable', status: res.status, requestId });
        }
        if (body.stop_reason === 'refusal') {
          throw new ProviderError('anthropic declined this request (stop_reason refusal)', {
            kind: 'bad_request', status: res.status, requestId: body.id || requestId
          });
        }
        const usage = body.usage || {};
        return {
          text: textOf(body),
          usage: { input: Number(usage.input_tokens) || 0, output: Number(usage.output_tokens) || 0 },
          model: body.model || model,
          requestId: body.id || requestId,
          format: 'none'
        };
      }, opts);
    }
  };
}

module.exports = { create, URL, VERSION, textOf };

// Provider interface + factory + shared retry logic (P2 spec).
//
//   complete({system, user, maxTokens, model, json}) → {text, usage:{input, output}, model, requestId, limits}
//
// Throws ProviderError{kind}:

//   rate_limited  the provider asked for a wait longer than one run should block — defer, keep the work
//   quota         credits or billing exhausted — defer, keep the work
//   too_large     the request is bigger than the provider allows per minute — rebatch smaller
//   invalid_output the provider rejected the model's own JSON (Groq json_validate_failed) — retried
//   auth          bad or missing key
//   bad_request   anything else 4xx
// Never logs headers, bodies, or the API key — only status, requestId, attempt.

const { log } = require('../log');
const { sleepMs } = require('../util');
const limits = require('./limits');

const TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;
const BACKOFF_MS = [2000, 8000, 30000];
const ATTEMPTS = 3;

class ProviderError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { kind = 'retryable', status = null, retryAfterMs = null, requestId = null } = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ProviderError';
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
    this.retryAfterMs = retryAfterMs;
    this.requestId = requestId;
  }
}

// HTTP status → error kind. Quota needs the body text, so it is decided by the caller.
function kindForStatus(status) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return 'auth';
  if (status === 429) return 'retryable';
  if (status === 413) return 'bad_request';
  if (status >= 500) return 'retryable';
  if (status === 408 || status === 409) return 'retryable';
  if (status >= 400) return 'bad_request';
  return 'retryable';
}

// retry-after in ms, uncapped: a long wait is turned into a deferral, not a long sleep.
function retryAfterMs(headers) {
  if (!headers || typeof headers.get !== 'function') return null;
  const raw = headers.get('retry-after');
  if (!raw) return null;
  const seconds = Number(raw);
  if (Number.isFinite(seconds)) return Math.max(0, seconds) * 1000;
  const when = Date.parse(raw);
  if (Number.isFinite(when)) return Math.max(0, when - Date.now());
  return null;
}
